description: Summer-phase ablation arm registry (exp15+). Tier A arms transform the SIGNED exp11 top-5 id lists (no new retrieval); Tier B arms (future) re-run retrieval with PipelineConfig overrides. Transform grammar: identity | slice:K | reverse | perm:i,j,... (0-based ranks over the exp11 list).

baseline_repro.hypothesis: Anchor: same-environment reference for every arm comparison; vs exp12-on-subset quantifies H5 environment drift.

reranker_off.hypothesis: The cross-encoder is the most load-bearing retrieval component (NDCG@5 indep 0.7405 post vs 0.6026 pre). Does removing it move faithfulness? Direct test of the retrieval->faithfulness link.

final_top_k_3.hypothesis: Fewer, higher-precision fragments -> less distractor mass in context. If faithfulness rises, the bottleneck is context noise, not evidence coverage.

context_reversed.hypothesis: Best evidence LAST instead of first. Tests primacy vs recency use of context (Liu et al. lost-in-the-middle, edge conditions).

context_lost_middle.hypothesis: Adversarial placement: rank-1 chunk dead center (position 3/5), rank-2 adjacent, worst at both edges. If faithfulness drops vs baseline, the model under-uses mid-context evidence (lost in the middle).
